It is not a grant and not a denial. can is yes, no or unknown; status is verified (measured, by the event named), reported (somebody said so, named) or unknown (nobody looked). checked_at is when somebody last looked; older than a day reads as STALE. Change this file only by a reviewed commit, with the event that is the evidence.
